# Reclamation Project: Wasteland Medicine
A recipe reference for Reclamation Project medicines and wasteland chems. Choose a chapter in the contents to see the exact ingredients, yields, heating requirements, and finishing steps.
## Getting started
[bold]Field crafting[/bold] uses whole plants and items through the crafting menu. [bold]Chemistry[/bold] uses measured liquids and extracts in a mixing container. These are different recipes: a broc flower is not 1u of broc flower extract.
Process plants with a mortar and pestle or appropriate chemistry equipment, collect the listed extracts, and measure each ingredient. A mortar and pestle can be crafted from two wooden planks. Check your container contents before mixing and allow space for every ingredient.
Recipes list reagent units (u). Scale all amounts by the same factor for larger batches. Recipes with heating requirements only react once their minimum temperature is reached. Temperatures are shown in Kelvin and Celsius.
Use separate containers for intermediate mixtures. Combine the prepared intermediates only when ready for the final recipe. Packaging recipes create an item; other recipes leave a reagent that still needs an appropriate container.
## Chapters
[bold]Field crafting:[/bold] Whole-plant recipes and inhaler assembly.
[bold]Core mixtures:[/bold] Stimpak serum, RadAway, antidotes, bitterdrink, and supporting medicines.
[bold]Advanced remedies:[/bold] Antibiotics, herbal medicines, radiation treatments, and emergency compounds.
[bold]Performance chems:[/bold] Jet, Mentats, Med-X, Psycho, and their wasteland variants.
[bold]Finishing medicine:[/bold] Conversion recipes for syringes, bottles, bloodbags, ointment, and smelling salts.
[bold]Toxin samples:[/bold] Poisons used in specialist antidote preparation.
## Important mixing notes
Dirty stimpak serum contaminates clean stimpak serum when mixed. Keep them separate.
Healing powder or healing poultice mixed with stimpak or super stimpak serum produces black goo and wastes the medicine. Do not combine these in a container.
Rad-X, super stimpak serum, and ultra stimpak serum have no direct synthesis recipe here. Scavenge or obtain them from another source when a recipe calls for them. Basic station chemistry recipes are outside this guide.
These are production recipes, not dosage instructions. Medicines and chems can have overdose effects, addiction, and dangerous interactions.
